shadows.name: product-window
shadows.purpose: Soft depth reserved for working product windows.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short entrances and directional hover movement.

components.name: Orange Button
components.description: The single saturated action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-orange { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--orange); border-radius: 0; background: var(--orange); color: var(--ink); font: 700 12px var(--font-body); transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-out), background 180ms ease; } .ds-button-orange:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: var(--paper); } .ds-button-orange:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-light); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: The default action on paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-dark { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 700 12px var(--font-body); transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-out), background 180ms ease; } .ds-button-dark:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange-light); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Availability Status
components.description: A literal availability state with color as a secondary cue.
components.css: .ds-status-available { padding: 5px 7px 4px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; color: var(--good); font: 400 8px/1 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Product Ledger Row
components.description: One product responsibility presented as a record, not a floating card.
components.css: .ds-product-row { min-height: 86px; padding: 0 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr 1.5fr 24px; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 12px var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-product-row strong { font: 900 22px var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.05em; } .ds-product-row span { color: var(--muted); } .ds-product-row:hover, .ds-product-row:focus-visible { background: var(--orange); }

narrative.overview: Tarantula uses spacious product storytelling, warm paper, near-black stages, soft material depth, and the existing monospace register. Real commands and honest empty states substantiate every claim.
keyCharacteristics: Orange used as a precise signal.
Soft depth reserved for product windows.
Real commands and honest empty states.

rules.name: The Orange Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Orange must denote brand, action, sequence, or emphasis. It is never a decorative glow.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Adjective Rule
rules.body: A command, state, output, or boundary must substantiate every large claim.

rules.name: The Flat Infrastructure Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs a soft shadow to be understood, its hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do use Signal Orange as a committed field or explicit action.
Do use one-pixel rules and square geometry to show hierarchy.
Do show real commands, outputs, status, and product boundaries.
donts: Don't make a generic AI-generated SaaS landing page.
Don't use decorative 3D cloud imagery, soft gradient blobs, or fake product screenshots.
Don't arrange interchangeable card grids or use product names whose responsibilities overlap.
Don't imitate Lakebed or BYOA visually; retain only their brevity, legibility, and agent-first discipline.
